text:
Priya: deploybot is proposing an unpin of runtime-2.8 -> prod in the 01:30 UTC window. Noting a potential SDK binding mismatch for a small set of customers.

deploybot: Proposal: unpin runtime-2.8 -> prod; window=2026-03-26T01:30Z; canary=ap-southeast; prechecks=kv-cache,bind-compat. Reply with :approve: or :hold:.

Noah: Quick context: SDK 2.4.5 changed the model-init handshake; hosted SDK hasn't rolled the hotfix. A few customers use the old binding flow.

Bea: Can we add a short-lived exclusion for requests with header X-Customer-Flag==legacy_bind instead of delaying the whole unpin?

deploybot: Suggested exclusion rule:
```
route_exceptions:
  - when: request.headers["X-Customer-Flag"] == "legacy_bind"
    action: keep_runtime
    runtime: runtime-2.7
    ttl: 8h
```

Priya: Good idea. Also throttle rollout: 25% for first 45m, auto-rollback if error-rate > 1.2x baseline for 5m. Ops, can you wire that?

op s-bot: Rollback policy added and alerts created. Error-rate threshold set. Notifications -> #eng-oncall and #eng-releases.

Noah: I'll open a tiny PR to deploy-configs and run a staging smoke.

Noah: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/deploy-configs/pull/805 26 staging applied, smoke ok.

Bea: LGTM. Marking :approve: for the unpin with the exclusion rule and rollout gating. Priya will post release note 20m before window.

Priya: Posting release note and will monitor metrics during rollout. End of thread.
